literal: Truthfulness, that which is called, what if asked: whatever even one harm without speaking.
translation: If asked what is called truthfulness, it is the speaking of words that are free from even the slightest harm.
modern: வாய்மை என்று சொல்லப்படுவது எது என்று கேட்டால், அது மற்றவருக்குச் சிறிதளவும் தீங்கு தராத சொற்களைச் சொல்வதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines truthfulness (வாய்மை) by focusing on its effect rather than mere factual accuracy. If asked what truthfulness is, the answer is speaking words that carry no harm (தீமை இலாத). The combination of 'யாது' and 'ஒன்றும்' stresses that not even the slightest harm should be caused by what is said. Therefore, true speech is fundamentally harmless speech.
